headline: Committee passes amendment 7-0; chair says road herbicide resolution will be deferred

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meeting.summary: The committee passed an amendment 7 to 0 after DHHL said it accepts the wording if it gets the full operating capacity of the wells. On Resolution 26-123, a Public Works weed killer request, the chair said it will be put off to a later meeting.
meeting.recap: The amendment removed a set figure of 1,728,000 gallons per day from the first paragraph of Section 7.[[0:12:38]] DHHL said it was fine with the wording as long as it gets the full operating capacity of the wells.[[0:15:53]] The committee took up Resolution 26-123, a request to let Public Works use herbicide (weed killer) at some road safety spots despite county pesticide limits.[[0:20:51]] One phone caller said they were against the waiver.[[0:47:10]] One member said they were leaning toward voting no, citing concern about runoff into the ocean.[[1:03:30]] The chair said the committee will defer the resolution, meaning put it off to a later meeting.[[1:32:23]]
meeting.next: One member said that when the resolution comes back, they want specific areas and a shorter time period.

moments.q: "That was a transcribing error on our part."
